 Advocate for applicant.

Shri Anuj Singh - P.L. appearing on behalf of respond
 Order

This is repeat (fourth) bail application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (439 of Cr.P.C.).
2.The applicant is in custody since 30.06.2024 in connection with Crime No.315/2024 registered at P.S.- Lordganj, District Jabalpur, (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(n),
506, 386, 376-D of IPC and Sections 3, 4, 5l & 6 of POCSO Act.
3. Prosecution story, in brief is that co-accused Dev Arya established physical relations with prosecutrix on false pretext of marriage.
4.
Learned Senior counsel for applicant submits that allegation against present applicant is that he prepared obscene video and obscene photographs of prosecutrix.

Learned Senior Counsel for applicant also submits that in the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:36422 2 MCRC-20252-2025 instant case, incident is said to have occurred from 15.11.2021 to 10.06.2024 and FIR has been lodged on 21.06.2024.
Main allegation is against co- accused Dev Arya, who established physical relations on the false pretext of marriage with prosecutrix.

It is also urged that prosecutrix's statements were recorded under Section 161 of Cr.P.C. on 23.06.2024 and Section 164 of Cr.P.C. recorded on 22.06.2024 and therein, no allegations have been leveled against present Ayush Jha vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5 August, 2025

1 applicant.
It is only in prosecutrix's statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. on 24.6.2024 that there is a reference to obscene video and photographs prepared by the applicant.

It is also urged that in the instant case, Investigation Officer has been examined and Cyber Forensic Officer,
Priyanka Agrawal (PW-4) has been examined.
As per testimony of Priyanka Agrawal, no obscene video has been found in mobile recovered from applicant.
It is also urged that in FIR, there is no reference to any obscene video or photographs prepared by the applicant.
In FIR, only allegation is that prosecutrix was having relation with Dev Arya and he established physical relation with him.

5. Learned Senior Counsel for the applicant also submits that there are material omissions,
contradictions and discrepancies in prosecutrix's statement recorded in the Court as well as her statement recorded under Section 161 and 164 of Cr.P.C., it is urged that in statement of prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. on 24.6.2024, allegation of extortion is leveled against Ashmit and it has also been alleged that Hamid established physical relations with prosecutrix.
It is also urged that Ashmit's second bail application has been allowed on 15.10.2024 and Hamid has also been NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:36422 3 MCRC-20252-2025 released on bail on 2.08.2024.
Applicant is in jail since 30.06.2024.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant be released on bail.
6. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the application.
7. Heard.
Perused record of the case.

8. Perused record of the case reveals that earlier applicant's bail applications were dismissed vide order dated 09.08.2024, 12.11.2024 and 22.3.2025 on merits and present bail application has been filed on 02.05.2025.
9.

It is correct that co-accused Hamid has been released on bail on 2.08.2024 and Ashmit has been released on bail on 15.10.20204 but present applicant's bail applications have been dismissed on merits even after co- accused Hamid and Ashmit were released on bail.
Further, there are observations of this Court in order dated 9.08.2024 passed in MCRC No.33386/2024 that applicant cannot claim any parity with the case of Mohd.Hamid Mansoori.

10. This Court has gone through and examined the FIR lodged by prosecutrix and prosecutrix's statement recorded under Section 161 of Cr.P.C. on 23.06.2024 and Section 164 of Cr.P.C. statement recorded on 22.6.2024 and also Section 164 of Cr.P.C. statement recorded on 24.06.2024 as well as record of the case.
11. Hence, there appears to be no substantial change in circumstances of the case, after dismissal of earlier bail applications of applicant.

12. It is also well established that Court testimonies of prosecution NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:36422 4 MCRC-20252-2025 witnesses cannot be assessed and evaluated on merits at the stage of consideration of bail application.

14. Accordingly, this application is dismissed.
